record.oneLiner: Copper is a CRM with a REST API for reading and writing most CRM resources.
record.verdictReason: Copper's own docs describe API keys generated by an admin in System settings, which is self-serve, plus OAuth2 for partners. No official Copper MCP server appears in Copper's docs; only third-party MCP servers exist, so existingMcp is community. The plan-eligibility question was not answered by the docs read, so accessLevel carries that uncertainty.

evidence.quote: There are two ways to access the Copper Developer API: API keys and OAuth2.0.
To generate an API token, in the Copper web app go to System settings > API Keys and click the 'GENERATE API KEY' button.
provides a RESTful interface with JSON-formatted responses to access most Copper resources.
Agent-callable tools for Copper through the Apideck MCP server.
